name: TUM-VIE
summary: 同步双目事件、灰度图像和惯性数据的手持及头戴序列，配有起止段运动捕捉真值。
summaryEn: Handheld and head-mounted sequences with synchronized stereo events, grayscale frames, IMU, and start/end motion-capture ground truth.
scale: Stereo frames at 20 Hz, IMU at 200 Hz, motion capture at 120 Hz
scaleZh: 双目图像 20 Hz、IMU 200 Hz、运动捕捉 120 Hz
licenseZh: 数据为 CC BY 4.0；代码为 BSD-2-Clause
access: Official sequence downloads and visualization script
accessZh: 官方序列下载及可视化脚本
verdict: 高时间分辨率观测演化
wmNote: 事件流与连续观测支持动态预测；运动捕捉真值主要覆盖序列起止段。
wmNoteEn: Event streams support temporal prediction; motion-capture truth mainly covers sequence beginnings and ends.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2108.07329] TUM-VIE: The TUM Stereo Visual-Inertial Event Dataset
evidence.statement: Hardware-synchronized event/frame/IMU streams record handheld and head-mounted motion trajectories; future prediction requires a causal sequence split.
